safety steps, then go on.water near outlets, lights or the panel: Stay out of that room, and don't touch switches while standing in water. Call the power company to cut the power; 911 for sparks. The booking goes on, marked urgent.

pf.rules.work authorization: Signed before any work, on the secure page.
pf.rules.assignment of benefits: Rosie's rule, in every state (a safe default, not any state's law): never taken through Rosie. Where a state's rules limit or void them, those rules apply too.
pf.rules.public adjuster: Rosie's rule, in every state (a safe default): the business never acts as the customer's adjuster or negotiates the claim through Rosie, and Rosie never says it will. A state's own adjuster rules apply on top.
pf.rules.deductible: Rosie's rule, in every state (a safe default): the deductible is never waived, paid or rebated by the business. A state's own rules apply on top.
pf.rules.mold: Where the state's rules require it: licensed work above the state's size, a plan from another company, the state told a set number of days before removal, and a clearance check after. One company never both assesses and removes the same job where the rules forbid it.
pf.rules.lead-safe work: In homes built before 1978, where the rules require it.
pf.rules.right to cancel: Work sold at the home comes with a written right to cancel for the period the state's rules set. Where a state lets a customer waive it for an emergency in their own words, that statement is signed on the secure page.
pf.rules.rebuild contract: Its own written contract; any deposit cap and cancel days come from the state's form.
pf.rules.emergency prices: In a declared emergency, the state's price limits apply.
pf.rules.records: Kept 7 years, or longer where the state's rules say so.
pf.rules.status: Draft: finalized once the state forms are filled in.
